=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
Requirement: Plan "Rollout — Removal trigger" at docs/plans/issue-4948-protected-path-twin-first-default-plan.md:90 — "the PR that makes #4785's sync live (it adds scripts/claude_twin_sync.py) removes the interim paragraph, the §28.C bullet, the agents.md sentence, and the sunset test's subject text; the sunset test fails that PR until it does."
Expected change site: tests/test_implement_plan_claude_command.py, function test_interim_twin_first_default_is_removed_when_the_4785_sync_lands (lines 377-383)
Evidence of absence: The test body (line 381-383) asserts INTERIM_TWIN_FIRST_MARKER not in _flat(TEMPLATE_COMMAND), INTERIM_TWIN_FIRST_MARKER not in _flat(COMMAND), and INTERIM_TWIN_FIRST_CLAUDE_MD_MARKER not in _flat(CLAUDE_MD). It does NOT assert that the agents.md interim sentence (agents.md:1116-1123, "Interim until #4785 (issue #4948): in a repo that has workflow-templates/.claude/...") is absent. Grep confirms zero references to AGENTS_MD or any agents.md path variable in the test module. A #4785 PR that removes the twin-command paragraph and the §28.C bullet but leaves the agents.md sentence intact would pass the sunset test while violating the plan's documented removal scope, which explicitly names "the agents.md sentence" as one of four targets the sunset test is meant to enforce. AD-4 (plan:102) states the test is the enforcement mechanism that makes removal happen "without anyone remembering"; without an agents.md assertion, a human could forget that part and the test would not catch it. The plan's own Tests section (line 78) says "Sunset guard: fails when scripts/claude_twin_sync.py exists and the interim default text is still in the twin or CLAUDE.md" — narrower than the Rollout section which adds agents.md — and the test matches the Tests section, not the removal-trigger contract in Rollout.
SEVERITY: MAJOR
ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
Requirement: Plan "Rollout — Removal trigger" at docs/plans/issue-4948-protected-path-twin-first-default-plan.md:90 states the #4785 sync PR "removes the interim paragraph, the §28.C bullet, the agents.md sentence, and the sunset test's subject text; the sunset test fails that PR until it does." Goal #6 at line 26 adds: "The removal trigger is recorded and enforced: a test fails once #4785's `scripts/claude_twin_sync.py` exists while the interim text remains." The sunset test is the only enforcement mechanism for the documented cleanup scope.
Expected change site: tests/test_implement_plan_claude_command.py, function test_interim_twin_first_default_is_removed_when_the_4785_sync_lands (currently lines 377–383); add assertions against the agents.md interim sentence and the master-session.md Q40 interim clause.
Evidence of absence: The test body asserts only three conditions: INTERIM_TWIN_FIRST_MARKER not in _flat(TEMPLATE_COMMAND), INTERIM_TWIN_FIRST_MARKER not in _flat(COMMAND), and INTERIM_TWIN_FIRST_CLAUDE_MD_MARKER not in _flat(CLAUDE_MD). The test module defines no AGENTS_MD or MASTER_SESSION_MD Path constant (verified at tests/test_implement_plan_claude_command.py:10-13, only ROOT/COMMAND/TEMPLATE_COMMAND/CLAUDE_MD are defined). The interim content exists and is documented as removal scope: agents.md:1116-1123 ("Interim until #4785 (issue #4948): in a repo that has `workflow-templates/.claude/`, the stage records … The PR that makes #4785's sync live removes this default.") and docs/operations/master-session.md:24 Q40 row clause ("Since #4948, stages in this repo record `Protected-path approval: phase N — twin-first (automatic, interim until #4785) (<date>)` themselves … This lasts until #4785 (Actions sync PR) lands."). A #4785 sync PR that removes only the twin paragraph and the §28.C bullet — leaving agents.md:1116-1123 and master-session.md:24 unchanged — would pass the sunset test while violating the documented removal scope the test is meant to enforce. The plan's Tests section (line 78) narrows the test scope to "the twin or CLAUDE.md," but the Rollout section (line 90) and Goal #6 (line 26) are the binding cleanup contract, and the test is the only contract that makes the cleanup happen without anyone remembering (AD-4). Minimal fix: extend the existing test with two assertions — one for the agents.md sentence (e.g. `assert "Interim until #4785 (issue #4948):" not in _flat(AGENTS_MD)`) and one for the master-session.md Q40 interim clause (e.g. `assert "Since #4948, stages in this repo record" not in _flat(MASTER_SESSION_MD)`), adding the two Path constants beside the existing ones. This is a contract-test extension only; no production code is touched.
SEVERITY: MAJOR
ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
